When a brutal string of ritualistic murders shakes a secluded rural village, a seasoned metropolitan detective is dispatched to assist the local constabulary. Plagued by fragmented memories and psychological trauma from his past, he must retrace his own steps in the fog-shrouded countryside to separate truth from delusion. As the body count rises and local secrets unravel, the investigator realizes the killer's identity is locked deep within the very mind he is struggling to trust.
